summary: A Marylebone medical aesthetics clinic with a 5.0 rating appears to lose bookings to empty review sections, thin pricing and unclear links.

findings.problem: The section 161 Patients. One Common Thread. appears to show no reviews, and the Google rating appears claimed but not shown.
findings.cost: A rating with no visible quotes asks the patient to take your word for it.
findings.fix: Real review quotes and a link to the source.

findings.problem: View Marylebone appears to link to the homepage and View All Treatments appears to open the booking page.
findings.cost: Links that go to the wrong place frustrate patients ready to explore.
findings.fix: Correct links to a clinic page and a treatment list.

findings.problem: Only three treatments appear to show a price, and no opening hours appear despite a same week appointments claim.
findings.cost: Patients who cannot see price or hours compare other clinics.
findings.fix: A fee guide and visible opening hours.

findings.problem: The footer appears to read MONUMEN and treatment names appear in two spellings.
findings.cost: Small errors lower trust at a premium price point.

redesign: Correct links and a fee guide.
